description: This repository's own Node and TypeScript workspace, which hosts the vendor-neutral Harness package.
architecture: Harness core stays vendor-neutral; stack assumptions belong to profiles and vendor instructions to adapters.
JSON Schema is authoritative and TypeScript types are generated from it.
Configuration validation and profile resolution never execute declared commands.
The legacy Java projects preserved in this repository are outside the npm workspace and are never built by it.
limitations: Applies to this repository's own tooling workspace, not to arbitrary Node applications.
No lint default is supplied, because the workspace does not define a lint command yet.
npm availability is assumed and never verified.
